wild_type_that_is_left.label: RAS/BRAF wild-type tumours on the left or in the rectum

left_that_is_wild_type.label: Left-sided or rectal tumours that are RAS/BRAF wild type

wild_type_that_is_right.label: RAS/BRAF wild-type tumours in the right colon

right_that_is_wild_type.label: Right-sided tumours that are RAS/BRAF wild type

msi_that_is_right.label: MSI-H tumours in the right colon

concordance.note: A referral cohort of metastatic disease. The study records side as Left or Right only: its rectal primaries are filed under Left, and transverse-colon primaries appear under both. The MSI-H and POLE rows stay in this matrix although the driver axis leaves them out, because removing them would change every column's denominator.

classification.name: colorectal driver class
classification.note: Computed from the study's repair call and its mutation and copy-number calls, not read off a label, in the order a treatment decision is made: MSI-H, then POLE, then BRAF V600E, KRAS G12C, any other KRAS or NRAS change at the codons the anti-EGFR labels name, ERBB2 amplification, and last, none of these. A tumour whose test for an earlier class could not be read is left unclassified rather than counted as wild type. HRAS is not counted as RAS, because the labels do not name it.

site-proximal.cohort_note: Primary tumours from TCGA PanCanAtlas whose site code falls in the proximal colon as Siegel 2026 defines it: caecum through splenic flexure. One sample per patient.

site-distal.cohort_note: Primary tumours from TCGA PanCanAtlas in the descending or sigmoid colon. One sample per patient.

site-rectum.cohort_note: Primary tumours from TCGA PanCanAtlas at the rectosigmoid junction or in the rectum, grouped together as Siegel 2026 groups them. One sample per patient.

rep-dmmr.cohort_note: TCGA's own MSI molecular class, which stands in for repair deficiency here. It is the study's call rather than the four-protein stain a pathology report gives, and it does not separate Lynch syndrome from sporadic tumours. One sample per patient.

contrasts.label: TCGA CIN and GS classes
contrasts.filter: SUBTYPE = COAD_CIN, READ_CIN, COAD_GS or READ_GS

rep-pole.cohort_note: TCGA's own POLE molecular class. A small group in any cohort, so read every figure on this card with its denominator. One sample per patient.

cohort.name: Colorectal Adenocarcinoma (TCGA, PanCancer Atlas)
cohort.filter: SUBTYPE = COAD_CIN, READ_CIN, COAD_GS or READ_GS

rep-pmmr-other.cohort_note: TCGA's chromosomally unstable (CIN) and genomically stable (GS) classes together: every tumour the study placed in neither its MSI nor its POLE class. One sample per patient.

cms1.cohort_note: Primary colon cancers from the AC-ICAM cohort (Leiden) that the study called CMS1. One sample per patient.

cms2.cohort_note: Primary colon cancers from the AC-ICAM cohort (Leiden) that the study called CMS2. One sample per patient.

cms3.cohort_note: Primary colon cancers from the AC-ICAM cohort (Leiden) that the study called CMS3. One sample per patient.

cms4.cohort_note: Primary colon cancers from the AC-ICAM cohort (Leiden) that the study called CMS4. One sample per patient.

cms-mixed.cohort_note: Primary colon cancers from the AC-ICAM cohort (Leiden) that the study called mixed CMS features. One sample per patient.
